vision_sensors.length: set by the game from the angle: 200 + 600 * |cos(angle)| (800 straight ahead, 200 sideways)

sensors.name: Abs Velocity
sensors.description: Measures the absolute velocity magnitude of the vehicle regardless of direction. Returns 0 when stationary and 1 at maximum speed. Useful for maintaining target speeds and understanding overall vehicle motion.

sensors.name: Wheel Angle
sensors.description: Measures the current angle of the vehicle's steering wheels. Returns -1 when turned fully left, 0 when straight, and 1 when turned fully right. Provides feedback about the vehicle's steering input.

sensors.name: Angular Velocity
sensors.description: Measures the rotational speed of the vehicle. Positive values indicate counter-clockwise rotation, negative values indicate clockwise rotation. Useful for detecting spins and controlling stability.

sensors.name: Grip
sensors.description: Measures the grip level under the vehicle based on the surface type. Returns different values for asphalt (high grip), dirt (medium grip), and ice (low grip). Essential for adapting driving style to different surfaces.

sensors.name: Front Velocity
sensors.description: Measures the vehicle's velocity in the direction it is facing. Positive values indicate forward motion, negative values indicate reverse motion. Helps distinguish between moving forward and backward.

sensors.name: Side Velocity
sensors.description: Measures the vehicle's velocity perpendicular to the direction it is facing. High values indicate sliding or drifting. Essential for detecting and controlling slides during cornering.

sensors.name: Direction
sensors.description: Measures how well the car's facing direction aligns with the track direction. Returns a continuous value from -1 (facing opposite) to 1 (facing forward), with 0 when perpendicular.

sensors.name: Front Accel
sensors.description: Measures the vehicle's acceleration in the direction it is facing. Positive values indicate forward acceleration, negative values indicate deceleration or reverse acceleration. Returns 0 when moving at constant speed. Helps the AI learn smooth speed control and braking.

sensors.name: Side Accel
sensors.description: Measures the vehicle's acceleration perpendicular to the direction it is facing. High values indicate rapid lateral movements or turns. Returns 0 when acceleration is purely forward/backward. Helps the AI detect and control cornering forces.

sensors.name: Wall Distance
sensors.description: Measures the distance from the vehicle to the nearest wall or track boundary. Returns 0 when touching a wall and 1 when far from any walls. Helps the AI maintain safe distances and avoid collisions.

sensors.name: Boost Capacity
sensors.description: Measures the current boost battery energy level. Returns 1 when fully charged and 0 when depleted. The battery drains while boosting and recharges when boost is not being used. Essential for managing boost usage strategically.

sensors.name: Track Curvature
sensors.description: Compares the track direction at the vehicle's position with the track direction a set distance ahead. Returns 0 when the track ahead is straight and approaches 1 when facing a sharp turn (≥180°).

outputs.name: Steering
outputs.description: Controls the steering of the vehicle (-1 full left to 1 full right).

outputs.name: Throttle
outputs.description: Controls the acceleration of the vehicle (-1 reverse or brake to 1 full throttle).

outputs.name: Handbrake
outputs.description: Controls the handbrake of rear wheels of the vehicle (0 no handbrake to 1 full handbrake).

outputs.name: Brakes
outputs.description: Controls the brake of all wheels of the vehicle (0 no brake to 1 full brake).

outputs.name: Boost
outputs.description: Boosts engine power using stored energy (0 no boost to 1 full boost). Drains a battery that recharges when not boosting. Higher values give more power but drain faster.

metrics.name: Distance
metrics.description: How far the car has traveled along the track.
metrics.details: Cumulative distance traveled along the track's centerline.

metrics.name: Speed
metrics.description: How fast the car has driven.

metrics.name: Steering Frequency
metrics.description: How much the car is steering.
metrics.details: Absolute value of the steering output [-1, 1].

metrics.name: Drifting
metrics.description: Time spent in a sustained drift.
metrics.details: Use Handbrake output for best results!

metrics.name: Actual Distance
metrics.description: Actual distance the car's body has traveled.
metrics.details: Warning: Rewarding this might cause the car to drive inefficiently.

metrics.name: Racing Line Efficiency
metrics.description: Ratio of track distance to actual distance.
metrics.tip: Positive = reward efficient lines & corner cutting
metrics.details: Calculated as `Distance / Actual Distance`. Higher is better.

metrics.name: Momentum Change
metrics.description: How much the car's speed changes.

metrics.name: Throttle Frequency
metrics.description: How much the throttle input changes.

metrics.name: Braking Frequency
metrics.details: Time where brake or handbrake output is on.

metrics.name: Wall Distance
metrics.tip: Positive = reward safety, Negative = reward risk-taking
metrics.details: Distance to the closest point on the track boundary.

metrics.name: Center Distance
metrics.description: Distance from the track's center line.
metrics.details: Distance to the closest point on the track's center line.

metrics.name: Network Novelty
metrics.description: How different the network is from others.
metrics.details: Vector distance from the average network weights of the generation.

metrics.name: Collision Count
metrics.description: How many times the car has crashed.
metrics.details: Warning: This might not work if 'Wall Collision Elimination' is enabled.

metrics.name: Best Lap Performance
metrics.details: Performance score based on the fastest completed lap. Higher is better. Requires at least one complete lap.

random_track.note: Pass track: {"random": {...}} to start_training. A new random track is generated every generation.
